title: justicia ellisii
intro: Justicia ellisii, commonly known as the 'Queen's Wreath', is a flowering plant species in the Acanthaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues and exhibits a range of health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Justicia ellisii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, that can modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antiviral activity. The bioactive constituents present in the plant have also been found to have potential therapeutic applications in treating conditions such as diabetes, cardiovascular diseases, and cancer.
